title: UFOs at nuclear facilities as future humans guarding their timeline

tellings.quote: UFOs showing up more around the creation of our nuclear programs and attempting to monitor shut down or in certain cases activate nuclear facilities
these UFOs seem to show up consistently around nuclear sites
tellings.difference: Describes nuclear sites as a lever on timelines rather than as sites being monitored or shut down.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the theory that UFOs show up at nuclear sites because future humans are managing their timeline.

as_told.title: UFOs at nuclear sites as leverage on timelines

tellings.quote: explanation that maybe a future time travel program represents an overlay over all of these nuclear sites
tellings.difference: Calls it a future time-travel program overlaying the sites and ties it to Lawrence Bell.
tellings.link_reason: Same host theory: UFOs at nuclear sites as the work of future humans, here put as a future time-travel program laid over those sites.

as_told.title: Future time-travel program overlaid on nuclear sites

related.note: Both concern UFOs appearing at nuclear sites, but this telling explains them as aliens under a prime directive waiting for humanity to become less violent, where the story explains them as future humans guarding their timeline.

plain: UFOs are said to show up most around nuclear sites, watching them, shutting them down or sometimes switching them on, and one idea is that they are humans from the future guarding their own timeline. Michels raises this himself on three episodes between 2023 and 2025. Once he calls nuclear sites a lever on timelines, and once he describes a future time-travel programme laid over all the sites, linking it to a man named Lawrence Bell.
